datasets.title: Oman: NDVI at Subnational Level
datasets.description: This dataset contains dekadal NDVI indicators computed from NASA's Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS) collection 6.1 from the Aqua and Terra satellite aggregated by sub-national administrative units. Included indicators are (for each dekad): 10 day NDVI ( vim ) NDVI long term average ( vim_lta ) 10 day NDVI anomaly [%] ( viq ) The administrative units used for aggregation are based on WFP data and contain a Pcode reference attributed to each unit. The number of input pixels used to create the aggregates, is provided in the n_pixels column.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/omn-ndvi-subnational]
datasets.details: Due to the nature of the Whittaker filter, the update of the timeseries (i.e. the addition of a new dekad) has an effect of preceding dekads which diminishes going back in time. Therefore slight variations can be expected for a certain number of dekads for every update.

entity.name: NASA Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS) Collection 6.1

lineage.description: Raw MODIS AQUA and TERRA 16-day composite products (MYD13C1 and MOD13C1 v6.1) were combined into 8-day synthetic products and aggregated to dekadal intervals. NDVI values were computed for each dekad and aggregated by WFP subnational administrative units. Long-term averages and percentage anomalies were calculated to provide drought monitoring indicators.

sources.name: NASA Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS) Collection 6.1
sources.description: Satellite-derived 16-day composite vegetation reflectance data from Aqua and Terra platforms, processed into 8-day synthetic products and aggregated to dekadal NDVI indicators

sources.name: WFP Administrative Boundaries
